Macrons

Consonantal i

Theme

Body, health & movement

contact lens noun

also contact lenses, contacts, lens

modern

M-O s.v. glasses: contact, contact lens

lēns adhaerēns

phrase: lēns, lentis f., with the participle of adhaerēre

a contact lens

Classically lēns is a lentil, whose shape gave the optical lens its name (Traupman 339: lēns optica); adhaerēns, clinging to the eye.

Other words

  • lēns exemptilis — a removable lens

    also used · modern · M-O s.v. glasses: contact, contact lens

    Exemptilis, removable, is rare (Col., Dig., in Lewis & Short).

See also doctor.

SourcesLewis & Short: lens · Lewis & Short: adhaereo · Lewis & Short: exemptilis

Morgan–Owens, Adumbratio: s.v. glasses: contact, contact lens.

John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, p. 339, checked against the searchable text of the book (11 November 2026).
